ready_components: train fit and deterministic anomaly score
design_choices: Paper does not identify the estimator producing its edge-weight matrix; abs-Pearson from training windows is an explicit local fallback. Prefer caller-supplied verified adjacency.
MLP projection axes/normalization dimensions are explicit local choices consistent with described alternating temporal/channel mixer, not certified author architecture.
Interior time grid j/(T+1), j=1..T; source samples shared across windows for chunk-independent deterministic scoring.
No early-stopping/validation scheduler or exact mTSBench preprocessing has yet been implemented; 1500 epochs is the paper maximum, not a validated local optimum.

ready_components: Euler CNF reverse-field density with Hutchinson or exact trace
missing: MLE-CNF and exact published FM/I-CFM U-Net baselines
design_choices: TimeMLP replaces unspecified U-Net parameterization; fixed standard Gaussian replaces paper learnable Gaussian. Neither is author equivalent.
Literal equation 12 only: data/prior independently sampled at uniform time. Aligned constant fields can attain zero cosine loss; loss does not establish bijectivity or distribution matching.
Paper Eq.11 applies a univariate inverse-function argument to multidimensional time-dependent vectors. This is retained as a documented theoretical concern, not silently repaired.
Euler backward integration over learned reverse field, valid continuous-change-of-variable sign. Dopri5 and exact paper preprocessing/threshold/point-adjustment protocols remain pending.
Training epochs and learning rate are local defaults, not values recovered from unpublished author settings.

missing: all metric evaluator and baseline pipelines
design_choices: Flat TimeMLP global field/encoder and latent=16/K=4 are explicit defaults; exact paper backbone, projector, schedules, and hyperparameter budget not specified in supplied full text.
lambda(t)=t and one-step endpoint estimate x+(1-t)*(global.detach()+lambda*residual) are explicit choices.
Global velocity is detached for WTA loss; selected expert S/R receive gradients, shared encoder/decoder and load-balancing router remain shared.
Conditional forecasting/imputation guidance, pretrained metric evaluators and comparison baseline experiment pipelines remain pending.

ready_components: RBF state/derivative GP posterior and per-trajectory MLE
missing: author network and dopri5 adjoint NODE baseline
design_choices: Standard diagonal zero-drift Kalman/RTS repairs printed smoothing gain/covariance equations; m0=y0,P0=1 are explicit initialization choices.
BB paper_literal implements printed Eq.8; gaussian_consistent instead uses 0.5*Pprime/P(t)*(x-m(t)), the velocity of Eq.7 Gaussian interpolation. Kept as distinct configurations.
GP paper_literal omits posterior means as printed Eq.10; gaussian_conditional restores derivative mean and centered state, the standard Gaussian conditional derivative.
GP MLE uses L-BFGS-B rather than unspecified author optimizer, shared RBF across independent state dimensions; dense covariance sampled jointly over queries.

TimeMLP differs from ambiguous 64/258-dimension architecture; RK4 replaces dopri5 during diagnostic simulation; main/appendix trajectory counts and batch size conflicts must be frozen before comparisons.
